transactions.isMissingTransaction=true (set by the balance-calculator's negative-balance detection), attributed to ONE debit (outgoing or fee) leg per transaction and grouped by (asset, walletId). The leg is: the one that set the flag (ledger isMissingPurchase), else a debit leg with a negative afterBalance, else outgoing before fee. A deficit caused only by a fee leg is listed under the fee asset.
